records.title: Edge-Ready Romanian Language Models: Training, Quantization, and Deployment
records.reason: Primary MDPI DOI https://doi.org/10.3390/ai7020061 could not be opened. The abstract reports Romanian small LMs, 5-bit quantization and Jetson Nano deployment, but the full text and deployment measurements/limits could not be verified.

records.title: HoRD: Robust Humanoid Control via History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning and Online Distillation
records.reason: HoRD distills robust simulated humanoid-control behavior into a student policy for sparse commands. Its expert routing/distillation context concerns robot control, not LLM model routing or inference serving.

records.title: LLM surprisal is necessary but not sufficient to capture English garden-path effects: Evidence from joint latent modeling of reading paradigms
records.reason: Psycholinguistic model of human garden-path processing that uses LLM surprisal as a predictor; not an LLM inference method.

records.title: LSGQuant: Layer-Sensitivity Guided Quantization for One-Step Diffusion Real-World Video Super-Resolution
records.reason: LSGQuant applies layer-sensitivity-guided quantization and mixed-precision refinement to one-step diffusion video-super-resolution DiTs. It reports quality near full precision and gains over other quantizers, but is task-specific diffusion generation rather than LLM quantization/serving; transfer to the linked learned-rotation LLM quantization family is uncertain.
